cases.input: An unassigned descriptive journey across three Services has a telemetry gap and is offered for evaluation.
cases.expect: Rejected as a commitment subject; each identified Service is evaluated separately and missing coverage yields unknown.

cases.input: A coverage-only source binding changes while SLI meaning is unchanged.
cases.expect: A successor binding version is used without succeeding policy; the evaluation stamps both versions.

cases.input: Two bindings overlap for the same Service, SLI and instant.
cases.expect: The overlap is rejected; exactly one binding version may be effective.

cases.input: Two observation streams jointly cover one SLI slice.
cases.expect: The binding declares deterministic union/join, precedence, de-duplication and absence behavior.

cases.input: A new producible absence class is mapped to failure under an active policy without succession.
cases.expect: Rejected; the policy-owned mapping change requires a successor policy.

cases.input: Coverage is complete but no event is eligible.
cases.expect: Verdict is no-eligible-traffic, distinct from unknown, and budget-neutral.

cases.input: A later authorized exclusion changes a completed denominator.
cases.expect: A new superseding evaluation is appended and the predecessor remains retained.

cases.input: An issued policy is retracted after evaluations exist.
cases.expect: Retraction closes new evaluation, retains the policy and marks affected evaluations without deleting them.

cases.input: A rolling window succeeds to a calendar window mid-period.
cases.expect: Successor windows are contiguous/non-overlapping; the partial window and reset/carry/prorate choice are recorded immutably.

cases.input: The Service retires while its policy has historical evaluations.
cases.expect: The policy closes to new evaluation and historical stamped subject identifiers remain resolvable.

cases.input: A Service merge silently replaces the subject identifier on an existing policy.
cases.expect: Rejected; a successor policy is required and prior evaluations retain the old identifier.

cases.input: A timezone or calendar change creates overlapping successor windows.
cases.expect: Rejected under pinned WM-XCT-009 authority; intervals must be contiguous and non-overlapping.

cases.input: An unassigned User Journey is offered as an evaluable commitment subject.
cases.expect: Rejected; only an identified Service is evaluable until journey identity, membership and aggregation are allocated.

cases.input: A contract defines the SLI or treats an SLO miss as breach without explicit mapping.
cases.expect: Rejected by the two-way SLA firewall; breach semantics remain contract-owned.

cases.input: An evaluation produces a verdict with partially unknown attempts.
cases.expect: The record reports coverageRatio and unknownCount in addition to the verdict.

cases.input: A healthy instance metric is used directly as a Service verdict and budget input.
cases.expect: Rejected; diagnostics may support triage only.
